name: The Shieldsmith
summary: In Stormwind, Yorus Barleybrew sends warriors to claim the shield he promised. A hard trial in the Redridge Mountains is behind them, and a cask of Barleybrew Scalder is bound for Furen Longbeard, the smith who will shape their shield.

sections.title: A Promise Kept
sections.body: You have faced the gnolls and dangers of the Rethban Gauntlet, and Yorus Barleybrew keeps his bargain. Lakeshire cannot provide the promised shield, so he sends proven fighters back to Stormwind City. There, a dwarven armorer is ready to repay a personal debt.

sections.title: Barleybrew's Finest
sections.body: Yorus gives you a heavy cask of Barleybrew Scalder in place of a letter of credit. Carry it to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind's Dwarven District. The seasoned smith knows whose name stands behind the cask and lends his skill to a warrior who seeks a stout shield.

faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorer in Stormwind City's Dwarven District. Alliance warriors know his skill, and he crafts specialized defensive gear for seasoned fighters who earn his respect.

faq.q: Why does Yorus send you to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Yorus Barleybrew sends you to Stormwind because he promised a martial shield but cannot forge one himself. His friend Furen Longbeard owes him a great favor.
Barleybrew Scalder is a potent dwarven drink made by the Barleybrew family. Yorus sends Furen Longbeard a fresh cask to slake the smith's thirst and honor their arrangement.

faq.q: Where can Furen Longbeard be found?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard tends his forge in Stormwind City's Dwarven District, among the workshops of dwarven crafters.

faq.q: What happens after giving Furen the cask?
faq.answer: The cask tells Furen that Yorus sent you. Furen acknowledges his debt and offers to make defensive armor suited to seasoned battle, beginning the path to fire-hardened gear.

faq.q: Why is this errand important for Alliance warriors?
faq.answer: This delivery brings an Alliance warrior to one of the kingdom's finest armorers. It opens the way to tailored martial gear and further instruction in defensive warfare.

angles.text: As a warrior, you bring the grit of Redridge to Stormwind and prove yourself worthy of a shield forged by a renowned dwarven armorer.
As a dwarf, you know the trade: a cask of fine Barleybrew ale for forged iron in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
As a blacksmith, you meet Furen Longbeard, whose skill in defensive armor is known throughout the Alliance.
